services.name: Monday After School Program
services.desc: The Simi Valley Cultural Arts Center is proud to announce the return of its YAP After School Theater Program-a dynamic, performance-based program designed to ignite creativity, build confidence, and foster self-expression in young artists! Join us every Monday for 10 weeks at the Simi Valley Cultural Arts Center as students rehearse and perform a musical play as part of our exciting Fall Theater Event. Along the way, participants will develop their own unique voice while exploring the magic of live performance. This fun, inclusive program helps students:Cultivate imaginationBuild stage presence and confidenceCollaborate with peers Experience the joy of creative

blurb: Please join us to celebrate the opening of EnFoque at the 3rd Annual Hispanic Heritage Festival at the Simi Valley Cultural Arts Center. Featuring over 40 portraits, this exhibition centers Ventura County’s Mexican Indigenous communities-including the Mixteco, Zapotec, Purépecha, Maya, Nahua, and Otomí.
